I should have talked to him before deleting his profile. Maybe I could have explained why I was doing it or found another solution, like just logging out instead of deleting. Another thing is empathy. My stepbrother was really upset. He was enjoying playing, and losing his save must have felt like losing something important to him. Even though I didn't think it was a big deal, it was to him. So, putting it all together, I think deleting his profile without telling him was wrong because it hurt his feelings and was unfair. I should have communicated with him and found a better way to handle the situation instead of just deleting it.
